task_definition.task_description: Please check the current BTC price and the EUR-to-USD exchange rate, then use that to place a $250 buy order. After that, verify my investment account status, get some trending alternative recommendations for the Sony XM5 black headphones, place one on hold, build the invoice for that hold and email it to me, then retrieve and email me my investment account balance sheet, and finally create and send me a high-priority post-trade purchase invoice notification by email.

user_input.query: Please check the current BTC price and the EUR-to-USD exchange rate, then use my budget currency, EUR, to place a $250 buy order for symbol BTC in my investment account. After that, verify the status of my investment account for user_id user_123. Then find some trending alternative recommendations in the audio category for the Sony XM5 black headphones, product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, and place 1 on hold. Build the invoice for that hold using stripe as the payment gateway and send it to me by email at user@example.com through the email channel. Also retrieve my investment account balance sheet and email that to user@example.com. Finally, create and send me a high-priority post-trade purchase invoice notification by email with priority high.
